name: Corporate Blue
use: Corporate decks. Palette and geometry measured from the corporate master deck and reference-architecture deck.
discipline: White field, no shadows, tinted rounded panels carrying grouped content, deep-blue circular icon badges, a full-width tinted callout band as the page's closing line. Dense and read-not-projected: type is small and hierarchy is carried by weight and colour, not size.
never: sky #00A3E6 as small text on white (2.84:1 — fails the contrast gate)
coloured slide backgrounds; the field is always white
